name: ShinkaEvolve
author: SakanaAI
one_liner: Sakana AI's program-evolution framework: an LLM edits code, an evaluation script scores it, an archive guides the search.

loop.judged_by: an evaluation program you point it at (eval_program_path)
loop.steers: an archive of successful solutions shared across evolutionary islands decides what to evolve next

not_proved: A better score means the program beats earlier candidates on your evaluation script, not that the result is optimal or generalizes beyond what that script tests.
